verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's Release Pipelines let users define stages with triggers and actions that move flags through rollouts automatically, including auto-generating change requests when promoting to production. Scheduled flags add time-based automatic changes. This is a real first-party rule-to-action capability, but it is scoped to flag release progression rather than general event-driven automation. Missing for 10: documentation of which event types can serve as triggers, general-purpose event-to-action rules beyond flag rollouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
